title: Restaurant Menu Engineering Worksheet (Stars, Plowhorses, Puzzles, Dogs)

listing.description_html:
Enter each dish's price, plate cost and units sold, and the worksheet classifies every item by contribution margin and popularity using the standard menu-engineering method, with food cost % and menu mix.

This worksheet applies the standard Kasavana and Smith approach. An item is popular when its share of the menu mix reaches 70% of an equal share (with 20 items, 70% of 5% = 3.5%), and profitable when its contribution margin is at or above the menu's weighted average. That gives four classes: Stars (popular and profitable), Plowhorses (popular, low margin), Puzzles (profitable, unpopular) and Dogs (neither).

What's included

  • Classifies every dish as Star, Plowhorse, Puzzle or Dog
  • Standard 70% popularity rule and weighted-average contribution margin
  • Food cost % and total contribution per item
  • Menu mix % from your point-of-sale counts
  • Count of items in each class for the whole section
  • PDF guide with the method, a worked example and what to do with each class

Who it's for

  • Restaurant and cafe owners
  • Chefs and kitchen managers reviewing a menu
  • Food truck and catering operators
  • Hospitality students and consultants

You get: restaurant_menu_engineering_worksheet.xlsx (Menu, Summary) and this guide.

Works in Excel 2016 or later, Excel for Mac and Excel on the web; opens in Google Sheets and LibreOffice.

This workbook is an analysis tool, not financial or business advice. Its results depend on accurate plate costs and sales counts from your own records.
